name: Mem0
description: Open-source and hosted memory layer that gives agents persistent cross-session memory.
descriptionZh: 开源 + 托管的记忆层，为 Agent 提供跨会话的持久记忆。
keyFact: Mem0 is an Apache-2.0 memory layer (with a paid Pro tier for some features) that adds persistent cross-session memory to agents via add/search APIs and an optional graph-based memory; it reported 65,000+ GitHub stars as of mid-2026 and is backed by Y Combinator.
keyFactZh: Mem0 是 Apache-2.0 许可的记忆层（部分功能归于付费 Pro 层），通过 add/search API 及可选的图记忆为 Agent 增加跨会话持久记忆；其 2026 年中报告 65,000+ GitHub 星标，并获得 Y Combinator 投资。
